name: app-real-estate-app-on-emerald-rock-stage
title: Real-estate app on an emerald 3D rock and ribbed glass stage
whatItIs: A tilted phone leans on green rocks in front of a ribbed glass panel with a vertical 'Orelax' wordmark and a leaf-house icon. The app screen has a dark green header, a buy/rent search card with a yellow button, a promo banner and a property card.
whatItMeans: Fresh, natural and trustworthy; yellow gives a friendly hit of energy against forest green.
techniques: Build the presentation set from the brand colours (green, yellow) in 3D.
Use ribbed glass as a soft translucent backdrop with vertical gradient stripes.
Set a giant faint wordmark vertically to add brand presence without clutter.
Tilt the phone against a rock to add dynamism and shadow.
bestFor: Property, travel and lifestyle app launches

vocabulary.definition: A fluted translucent texture with vertical ridges.
A device angled to feel dynamic.
A raised panel holding search fields and one primary button.
